hits.title: SEG Solar to open new US 4GW module assembly plant in Q3 2026
hits.snippet: # SEG Solar to open new US 4GW module assembly plant in Q3 2026 [Americas](https://www.pv-tech.org/regions/americas/) ## [Clearway Energy renewables & storage generation rises 16% year-on-year in Q2 2026](https://www.pv-tech.org/clearway-energy-renewables-storage-generation-rises-16-year-on-year-in-q2-2026/) ![Aerial view of SEG Solar's new module assembly plant in Texas](https://www.pv-tech.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/SEG-Solar-to-expand-US-module-capacity-with-4GW-assembly-plant-in-Texas.jpg)The new module assembly plant in Texas will increase SEG Solar’s annual module nameplate capacity to 6GW in the US. Solar manufacturer SEG Solar has unveiled a new module assembly plant in the US with a 4GW annual nameplate capacity. This new facility will be located in Houston, Texas, where it already [has an operational 2GW module assembly plant](https://www.pv-tech.org/seg-solar-commissions-2gw-module-manufacturing-facility-texas/) since 2024, expanding the company’s annual nameplate capacity in the US to 6GW. hits.snippet: # Industry Voices Come Together at SEG Solar Factory Opening TOMBALL, Texas, August 7, 2026— SEG Solar (“SEG”), a leading U.S. solar module manufacturer, welcomed leaders from across the solar industry, economic development organizations, workforce agencies, certification bodies, media outlets and the broader business community to celebrate the opening of its second U.S. manufacturing facility in Tomball, Texas.
